name: knowledgevoice
description: KnowledgeVoice - single Vercel project (React/Vite frontend + Express API as Vercel Functions). voice-agent/ is a separate long-running worker, deployed independently.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
